title: Finite normalization transfers boundary dimension
statement: For the finite localized relative normalization, a boundary target stalk of Krull dimension at least two implies that every source stalk above it has Krull dimension at least two.

proof.text: Smooth ascent of normality gives normal domain stalks on C via RingHom.Smooth.isNormalRing. The projection l is a flat preimmersion because fromSpecStalk s is one. Its stalk maps are surjective by preimmersion and injective by flat-local faithful flatness, so normality transports to L through the resulting stalk ring isomorphisms.

Apply stalk_normalization_normal_and_dense to obtain normality of N and density of n inverse image of the original open. The relative normalization recovers the finite etale map on C_U: use the pullback of P -> C_U along the open immersion, toNormalization for its finite map, normalizationPullback, and the pullback/restriction isomorphism. Restriction commutes with the further pullback l, so n is etale over V=l inverse image(C_U). Apply finite_normal_dense_etale_stalk_goingDown to n.

For any local map with going down, the maximal ideal of the target local ring lies over the maximal ideal of the base local ring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap). Every base prime lies beneath its maximal ideal, so going down supplies a target prime above it. Hence the induced spectrum map is surjective. Apply ringKrullDim_le_of_goingDown_of_surjective, and compose that inequality with hboundary at n(z).

proof_origin.place: Tags 033C, 0357, 00H8, 00OH; same normal-component going-down route, with geometric stalk glue split off.

theorem stalk_normalization_boundary_dimension_two_transfer {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c]
    (U : S.Opens) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
      (R := S.presheaf.stalk s) (S.presheaf.stalk s))
    (hboundary : let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
      ∀ y : (pullback c a : Scheme.{u}),
        y ∉ (pullback.fst c a) ⁻¹ᵁ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U) →
        (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim ((pullback c a).presheaf.stalk y)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    IsFinite n → ∀ z : (pullback
      (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}),
      n z ∉ (pullback.fst c a) ⁻¹ᵁ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U) →
      (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim
        ((pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
          (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk z)
